info.title: TenkaCloud Simulator API
info.description: Independent local cloud simulator. AWS S3 is the first provider. No real infrastructure is created. This document describes only implemented operations. S3 wire APIs retain their XML formats; simulator IAM control is explicitly a separate JSON API. Use unsigned requests or dummy TCSIM SDK credentials. Default principal simulator-admin has full sandbox access. For IAM exercises send x-simulator-principal. SQLite is ephemeral by default; --state persists it. See /_simulator/v1/capabilities for limits and deviations. Lambda supports a bounded Python 3.12 ZIP subset through the native REST paths below. Host Python is not required. Function-internal SDK/network and Function URLs remain unsupported. CloudFormation supports inline Python AWS::Lambda::Function with index.handler, existing local role, Ref/Arn and explicit DependsOn. Caller requires Lambda Create/DeleteFunction and iam:PassRole; tagged creation also requires lambda:TagResource. No SDK/network bridge or managed-policy grants.

post.summary: SSM JSON or CloudFormation Query operation
post.description: Native regional root endpoint. SSM: X-Amz-Target AmazonSSM.PutParameter, GetParameter, GetParameters, GetParametersByPath, DescribeParameters, DeleteParameter. CloudFormation: CreateStack, DescribeStacks, DeleteStack; only S3 buckets, SSM parameters, inline Python Lambda functions and one inline IAM identity policy per role. Unsupported options fail. Real credentials and session tokens are rejected. Create/DeleteStack also require the caller to allow the underlying S3/SSM/IAM/Lambda actions; CAPABILITY_IAM grants no permissions. No service RoleArn or general CloudFormation lifecycle is supported.

put.description: Requires s3:CreateBucket on the bucket ARN. Empty body creates in us-east-1. Other supported regions require LocationConstraint. Bucket subresources: use ?versioning for Get/PutBucketVersioning; ?publicAccessBlock for Get/Put/DeletePublicAccessBlock; ?versions for GET ListObjectVersions. Do not combine subresources or send list-type with them. Versioning Status is Enabled/Suspended; MFA Delete is unsupported. Public access block stores the four bucket-level booleans; public ACLs/policies remain unsupported. Bucket tags use ?tagging. GET requires s3:GetBucketTagging; PUT/DELETE require s3:PutBucketTagging. User-defined metadata only, no ABAC/billing/system tags. An empty replacement removes the set; an absent set returns NoSuchTagSet.

get.summary: List objects or get bucket location
get.description: ListObjectsV2: keep list-type=2; supports prefix, delimiter, max-keys and continuation. GetBucketLocation: omit list-type and send an empty location query. S3 uses one path for these two wire operations; this reference does not invent a REST adapter. Bucket subresources: use ?versioning for Get/PutBucketVersioning; ?publicAccessBlock for Get/Put/DeletePublicAccessBlock; ?versions for GET ListObjectVersions. Do not combine subresources or send list-type with them. Versioning Status is Enabled/Suspended; MFA Delete is unsupported. Public access block stores the four bucket-level booleans; public ACLs/policies remain unsupported. Bucket tags use ?tagging. GET requires s3:GetBucketTagging; PUT/DELETE require s3:PutBucketTagging. User-defined metadata only, no ABAC/billing/system tags. An empty replacement removes the set; an absent set returns NoSuchTagSet.
